name: Lightium TFLN
description: Lightium's 600nm X-cut Thin Film Lithium Niobate platform on 8.2um SiO2 BOX. Supports 20 possible waveguide cross-sections with 3 TFLN etch layers.

PAYLOAD.name: PAYLOAD
PAYLOAD.description: Outline of the design block. Not a process layer. All structures must be fully covered by PAYLOAD.

TFLN_WG1.name: TFLN_WG1
TFLN_WG1.description: First TFLN etch layer: 400nm etch depth in 600nm LNOI. Primary waveguide layer.

TFLN_WG2.name: TFLN_WG2
TFLN_WG2.description: Second TFLN etch layer: 100nm etch depth in 200nm LNOI. Shallow etch for mode converters.

TFLN_WG3.name: TFLN_WG3
TFLN_WG3.description: Third TFLN etch layer: 200nm etch depth in 200nm LNOI. Full etch in thin film region.

a-Si_WG.name: a-Si_WG
a-Si_WG.description: Amorphous silicon layer - 1um of a-Si. Sidewall angle > 80 degrees.

MET1.name: MET1
MET1.description: First metal layer - 1.5um copper. For electrodes and routing.

VIA.name: VIA
VIA.description: VIA access layer - 300nm copper. Must be engulfed by MET1 and MET2 with 1um margin.

MET2.name: MET2
MET2.description: Second metal layer - 1.5um copper. For electrodes and routing.

PAD_ACCESS.name: PAD_ACCESS
PAD_ACCESS.description: VIA opening for pads - 500nm. Must be engulfed by MET2 with 1um margin.

PAD.name: PAD
PAD.description: Aluminum pad definition - 1.2um aluminum. PAD_ACCESS must be engulfed by PAD with 1um margin.

CLD_OPEN.name: CLD_OPEN
CLD_OPEN.description: Cladding opening for optical access. Forbidden on top of BOX oxide or copper.

DEEP_GRID.name: DEEP_GRID
DEEP_GRID.description: Chip release borders. Provides smooth facets for edge couplers. 150um DEEP_GRID around chip is mandatory.

LN_Xcut.name: LN_Xcut
LN_Xcut.description: X-cut Lithium Niobate. n_o in X,Z planes, n_e in Y axis for EO modulation.

aSi.name: aSi
aSi.description: Amorphous silicon for mode conversion and high-confinement structures.

Cu.name: Cu
Cu.description: Copper for electrodes. Optical index not relevant for metal layers.

WG1_rib.name: WG1_rib
WG1_rib.description: Primary waveguide: 400nm etch in 600nm TFLN, 200nm slab remaining.

WG2_shallow.name: WG2_shallow
WG2_shallow.description: Shallow etch: 100nm etch in 200nm TFLN, 100nm slab remaining.

WG3_full.name: WG3_full
WG3_full.description: Full etch: 200nm etch in 200nm TFLN, strip waveguide.

WG1_strip.name: WG1_strip
WG1_strip.description: Fully etched strip waveguide in 600nm TFLN.

design_rules.description: Minimum design gap (accounts for sidewall angle: Gap_design = Gap_fab + 560nm)
Minimum feature size for metal layers
Minimum feature size for chip release
Mandatory DEEP_GRID width around chip perimeter
